paper_title: Joint Detection of Fraud and Concept Drift inOnline Conversations with   LLM-Assisted Judgment
caption: A runtime comparison between our ensemble model and various LLM models on the SEconvo dataset
model_annotation: This bar chart illustrates a runtime comparison of different models in a streaming environment. The horizontal axis represents the model name, with categories labeled “Our Joint Framework”, “ChatGPT”, “DeepSeek”, “LLaMA”, and “Claude”, presented in that order. The vertical axis is labeled “Runtime (seconds)” and displays a linear scale ranging from 0 to 400, with tick marks every 50 units. Two sets of bars are presented for each model: a green bar representing “Our Joint Framework” and a light blue bar representing “LLM Models”. For “Our Joint Framework”, the bar height is approximately 77 seconds. For “ChatGPT”, the “LLM Models” bar reaches a height of approximately 190 seconds. “DeepSeek” shows an “LLM Models” bar with a height of 365 seconds, while “LLaMA” has a bar height of 172 seconds, and “Claude” is represented by an “LLM Models” bar of approximately 243 seconds. The bars are arranged side-by-side for each model category, allowing for a visual comparison of the runtime for each respective framework. No bars are visibly emphasized through shading, bolding, outlining, or annotations.
